anderson.q: A circular vortex loop of radius R and strength Γ. The induced velocity at the centre of the loop is:
anderson.explain: Biot-Savart integral: every element dl is perpendicular to r so V = Γ/(4π) · 2πR/R² = Γ/(2R).
